def process(constitutionBeach):
    import pandas as pd

    df = constitutionBeach.copy()

    # Parse date and filter to 2024
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['date'].dt.year == 2024].copy()

    # Standard: Enterococcus < 104 counts per 100 mL
    ent_cols = ['Enterococcus', 'Enterococcus.1', 'Enterococcus.2']

    # Determine pass/fail per sampling point; treat missing as NA (not pass or fail)
    for c in ent_cols:
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')

    pass_df = df[ent_cols].lt(104)

    # For each day, check if there exists at least one pass and at least one fail among non-missing points
    any_pass = pass_df.any(axis=1)
    any_fail = (~pass_df).where(df[ent_cols].notna()).any(axis=1)

    split = any_pass & any_fail

    return pd.DataFrame({'splitStandardDays2024': [int(split.sum())]})
